title: Psalms 31
paragraphs: ¹ In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness. ² Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me. ³ Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me. ⁴ Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge. ⁵ Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, LORD, my faithful God.

⁶ I hate those who cling to worthless idols; but I put my trust in the LORD. ⁷ I will be glad and rejoice in your faithful love, for you have seen my suffering and known the anguish of my soul. ⁸ You have not handed me over to the enemy; you have set my feet in a wide open place. ⁹ Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress — my eyes, my soul, my body are worn with grief. ¹⁰ My life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my sin, and my bones waste away.

¹¹ I have become a reproach to all my enemies, even more to my neighbors, a source of dread to those who know me — those who see me on the street flee from me. ¹² I am forgotten, as though I were dead and out of mind; I have become like a broken jar. ¹³ I hear the whispered threats of many; terror is on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life. ¹⁴ But I trust in you, LORD; I say, "You are my God." ¹⁵ My times are in your hands; rescue me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

¹⁶ Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your faithful love. ¹⁷ LORD, do not let me be put to shame, for I have called on you; let the wicked be shamed, let them lie silent in the grave. ¹⁸ Let lying lips be silenced — those who speak arrogantly and contemptuously against the righteous. ¹⁹ How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you lavish on those who take refuge in you before the eyes of everyone! ²⁰ In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human plots; you keep them safe in your dwelling from the strife of tongues.

²¹ Praise be to the LORD, for he showed me his wonderful love when I was in a besieged city. ²² In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help. ²³ Love the LORD, all his faithful people! The LORD guards those who are true to him, but fully repays the proud. ²⁴ Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the LORD.
